segments.text: I found there lying for me the two first Parts of your great work,
— I thank you most truly for this magnificent present; & feel much flattered & gratified by this mark of your esteem.— I have eagerly turned over
plainly see that there will be much of the highest interest to me.—
With my cordial thanks for your kindness | I beg leave to remain | My dear Sir | Yours sincerely obliged |
